about_the_game:
“You’re trapped in a dream. And the only way out is to go deeper in.”

Have you ever had a nightmare, where you knew you were dreaming… but couldn’t wake up?
Same operating system. Same browser. Same illegal websites.
But something’s off.

And then you start to remember. And then you start to panic.
The line between dream and reality fades as you search for an exit.

Welcome back to the Deep Web.

It’s changed. Broken. Infected by your own subconscious.
You don’t know how to escape. You don’t even know if escape is real.

Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a deep web exploration adventure — a standalone spinoff of Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and subconscious fears, this game tells a story based on a deep and forgotten folklore.

  • Immersive desktop simulation. Apps, websites, files — all twisted by the dream

  • New applications, new content, an entirely new experience

  • Uncover dozens of new puzzles, encrypted websites, and lost data fragments

  • Discover new corners of the deep internet, now even darker

  • New horror tropes: investigate the internet’s most forbidden secrets — even the ones that were meant to stay buried.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.
